title: Valenzuela-Malolos NSCR line operational by early 2028 -- Dizon
summary: The North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) project"s Valenzuela City to Malolos, Bulacan segment will be operational by early 2028, according to Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon.

blocks.text: The North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) project’s Valenzuela City to Malolos, Bulacan segment will be operational by early 2028, according to Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon.
Dizon made the announcement during his inspection of the NSCR Malanday depot in Valenzuela City on Wednesday, according to a Facebook post by the Department of Transportation (DOTr).
Once the segment is operational, the travel time between the Valenzuela City and Malolos will be cut to only 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, the entire NSCR, a 147.26-kilometer elevated railway linking Central Luzon, Metro Manila and Calabarzon, is expected to be finished by 2032 with complete operations targeted by 2033.
Dizon also said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered for the fast-tracking of the NSCR project’s construction. —Ted Cordero/RF, GMA News
